definition: Preference learning is a subfield of machine learning that focuses on modeling and predicting preferences based on observed preference information.
details: Preference learning typically involves supervised learning using datasets of pairwise preference comparisons, rankings, or other preference information.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Preference learning — a small key that opens a big door.
